data.name: Krishav
data.gender_notes: Krishav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Krishav is derived from the Sanskrit name Krishna, which means 'dark' or 'black' and is also an epithet of the Hindu god Vishnu. The name Krishna is also associated with the god Krishna, who is revered in Hinduism for his divine love, wisdom, and mischievous antics. The name Krishav carries the meaning “Dark, God, Wealthy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krishav usually hope their child will grow to embody dark, god, wealthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine love, wisdom, and mischief.
data.etymology: Krishav belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dark, God, Wealthy.”
